reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "We have changed the default value of `Certificate.Spec.PrivateKey.RotationPolicy` from `Never` to `Always`. > 📖 Read Release 1.18 notes for more information.", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Certificates without an explicit rotationPolicy now generate a new private key on re-issuance (default Always instead of Never); this is feature gated and enabled by default, and the gate can no longer be turned off from release 1.19.
consequence.remediation: Explicitly set rotationPolicy: Never on Certificate resources to keep the old behavior, or turn off the feature gate in this release and set rotationPolicy: Never before 1.19.

proposed.statement: The default of Certificate spec.privateKey.rotationPolicy changed from Never to Always, so re-issued certificates without an explicit rotationPolicy now get a new private key.
